data.long_meaning: Feminine form of Sharva (god of good fortune, happiness and prosperity) + Kaayan (god of knowledge, wisdom and learning). The name Sharvikaayan carries the meaning “Goddess Sharvi + God Kaayan” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvikaayan usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess sharvi + god kaayan and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvikaayan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
